criteria_assessments.reason: Baseline commit edca4aee was executed in an isolated, source-verified image (verified_image_id sha256:4c605fe6…, source_limit 'Image /app matched every tracked Git blob before execution'). I decoded the embedded command from the report JSON: the hash-bound startup.mjs (sha256 9bdfafe60b8fef484a7aafc6f1ce760d77009a183c5a7ab53b3c86fc64cb2662, identical in both runs) spawns the real gateway (/app/src/entry.ts gateway, channels/providers enabled, skip-env deleted, default sidecar startup) and, on observing 'sidecars.worker-environments starting', acquires a genuine external BEGIN IMMEDIATE write lock on the app's own state DB. Both runs (implementer B1 and independent-verifier B2) show the identical real chain: workspace-recovery attempt 1 → real application diagnostic 'operation=placementJournals.prune … failureKind=lock-contention sqlitePrimaryCode=5' after a ~5.2s busy wait → '[gateway] sidecars failed to start: Error: database is locked' while lockHeld=true → stability bundle gateway.startup_failed → 'Gateway failed to start: database is locked. Run openclaw gateway status --deep' → spontaneous gateway-exit code 1 (cleanupStarted=false), with exactly one attempt (no retry). Commands, phase logs and lock timings are fully preserved in the hash-verified reports.

The same hash-bound startup.mjs was re-run at candidate commit 54710b123 (image sha256:44c82395…, blob-verified) three times (R1 implementer, R3, R4 independent-verifier). Transient scenario: real lock acquired at the worker-environments stage, attempts 1–2 failed with real lock-contention diagnostics, attempt 3 started before release and completed after it (attempt3 ended 40904ms ≥ lock-released 40842ms), then active reconciliation started after release, worker stage and channel-start completed, '[gateway] ready' logged, and /readyz returned HTTP 200 only after release (50452ms ≥ 40842ms) with prematureHttpResponses=0 and clean exit 0 — Gateway reached ready without human restart and without suppressing channels. Persistent-lock scenario (same runs): 4 attempts then the fatal 'sidecars failed to start: Error: database is locked' with lock still held, spontaneous exit 1, never ready, zero premature HTTP responses — a persistent lock is NOT masked as success. Other errors are not masked either: source rethrows non-lock errors immediately (src/gateway/server-startup-sqlite-retry.ts), and unit tests 'does not suppress unrelated errors' (rejects with the original error after 1 call) and the 4-attempt cap passed in R2/R5 and in the full 109/109 JSON runs R6/R7. The decoded journal.mjs harness exercised the real production modules (recoverGatewayWorkerPlacementWorkspaces + retryStartupSqliteLock + placement store): first failure is a verified isSqliteLockError with the reconciliation journal retained, retry after ROLLBACK restores the workspace to base content and clears the journal (attempts=2), and shutdown during the lock retries nothing and retains the journal. The fix (bounded retry wrapping the measured startup.workspaces reconcile inside the sidecars.worker-environments startup path in src/gateway/server-worker-placement-startup.ts) directly addresses the reported bug without lowering any condition.
